mapper.select: SELECT a.ano, a.astatus, a.adate, a.aupdate, a.jno, a.rno, a.mno, j.jtitle AS jtitle, c.cname AS cname FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON j.jno = a.jno LEFT JOIN company c ON c.cno = j.cno WHERE a.mno = #{mno} ORDER BY a.ano DESC

SELECT a.ano, a.astatus, a.adate, a.aupdate, a.jno, a.rno, a.mno, j.jtitle AS jtitle, c.cname AS cname, m.mname AS mname FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON j.jno = a.jno JOIN company c ON c.cno = j.cno JOIN member m ON m.mno = a.mno WHERE a.jno = #{jno} AND c.mno = #{mno} ORDER BY a.ano DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET astatus = #{astatus}, aupdate = SYSDATE WHERE ano = #{ano}
